messages:
Aisha (people-ops): Hey team — launching the 'Sunburst Recognition Tour': a rolling recognition cart + pop-up mini-cafe to celebrate Q2 wins across offices July 18–29. Need volunteers, one lead per site, and confirmation on spot-award payroll cutoffs. Can folks weigh in on logistics and budget? :sun_with_face:
Maya (people-ops): Dates look good. Kits ready for 6 hubs (SF, NYC, London, Berlin, Toronto, Dublin). Estimated counts: 120 kits total. Shipping deadline to hubs: July 8. Ops — can you confirm pickup windows and any restrictions?
Diego (facilities): We can handle van pickups July 9–10, 9:00–14:00. Need final pallet labels by July 7 so we can schedule the crew.
Sam (finance): Heads up on spot awards — these go through payroll as taxable wages. To make the July 15 payroll run, nominations must be submitted by COB July 5. Anything after that goes to August payroll or an off-cycle run (which carries an ops fee).
Jenna (eng): Ian lead NYC day (July 19). Ian bring 2 folks to help with kit distro and photos.
Aisha (people-ops): Thanks Jenna! Still need leads for SF, London, Berlin, Toronto, Dublin. Volunteers drop a \u2705 and preferred site.
Anton (people-ops): Signup sheet: https://tiny.redwood/sunburst-signup — pick role (lead/volunteer/photographer) and add t-shirt size if you want merch.
Priya (people-ops): Quick policy Q: Are managers allowed to hand out gift cards, or should we stick to payroll spot awards? Some managers prefer a $25 physical card option.
Sam (finance): Preference is payroll spot awards for traceability. Small gift cards/merch (<$50) are allowed via petty cash but require receipts + GL codes; we'll reconcile at month end.
HR-bot: Reminder: For payroll entries include employee ID and manager approval screenshot in nomination form. Missing IDs will delay processing. :white_check_mark:
Maya (people-ops): Draft manifest — confirm counts and shipping codes:
```
SF: 40 kits (box A1)
NYC: 30 kits (box B2)
London: 15 kits (box C1)
Berlin: 10 kits (box C2)
Toronto: 15 kits (box D1)
Dublin: 10 kits (box D2)
```
Diego (facilities): OK on box counts. Use shipping code STD-REC-07. Pallet labels will be generated once Maya confirms final counts.
Priya (people-ops): Payroll/tax follow-up — for international recipients local tax rules apply. I'll loop in payroll-ops and flag nominees by country so we can decide gross-up per jurisdiction.
Sam (finance): Confirmed. Flag country on nomination form so payroll can calculate taxes/grossup where needed.
Aisha (people-ops): Volunteers so far: Jenna (NYC lead), Omar (SF volunteer \u2705), Lina (London lead \u2705). Still need Berlin, Toronto, Dublin leads. Managers must submit nominations by July 5 via the signup form.
Diego (facilities): Van pickup tentatively scheduled July 9 @ 10:00 for SF/STG hub. I put a hold on the facilities calendar and will update when labels are ready.
Maya (people-ops): Action items recap:
- Volunteer leads per site (Aisha)
- Final kit counts + pallet labels by July 7 (Maya)
- Spot award nominations in by July 5 for July payroll (Managers)
- International tax confirmations (Priya)
- Shipping pickup July 9–10 (Diego)
Please react with :thumbsup: when youaretake an item.
HR-bot: Checklist created: https://tiny.redwood/sunburst-checklist — will post reminders 7 days and 48 hours before pickups.
Aisha (people-ops): Thanks all. We
re doing a dry run of the cart setup July 15 in SF — volunteers welcome to help test layout and flow.
